summary: The team is in execution mode on two fronts: fixing an Outlook lockout that's disrupting daily work, and advancing the knowledge website redesign while finalizing the visibility plan for Asia Star and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout caused by stale cached credentials, which requires the team to delete and re-add accounts on all devices and confirm a backend unlock with IT. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is moving forward: Joseph will share the HTML concept, and a 30-minute feedback session with Julie and the team lead will finalize changes for Joker to implement. The global marketing strategy is focused on prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for search/AI visibility, with Joseph drafting the visibility plan and researching target audiences. Upcoming work includes launching the Intelligent China webpage and preparing for the November 27 Cartier Women's Initiative roundtable, while longer-term tasks like the MBZUAI thank-you piece and ESG report are on the radar.
